description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5935013886523 COVER,ELECTRICAL CO: Line 0001 Qty 1377 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0067 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
